title.hr: Dipol kroz vrijeme: blisko polje, daleko polje i petlje
title.en: The dipole over time: near field, far field and loops

concept.hr: Blizu dipola silnice izlaze i vraćaju se; od oko λ/4 petlje se odvajaju i odlaze
concept.en: Near the dipole lines go out and back; from about λ/4 loops break away

summary.hr: Silnice kratkog dipola kroz jednu periodu, c konačna ili beskonačna. Sonda čita E, H, fazu i E/H: preko 1000 Ω blizu, 257 Ω najmanje, pa 377 Ω.
summary.en: A short dipole's field lines over one period, c finite or infinite. A probe reads E, H, their phase and E/H: over 1000 Ω close in, 257 Ω at least, then 377 Ω.
